# Flow AI (flowai.co.nz) · Amber Lan · AI marketing engineer · Auckland, New Zealand

> Flow AI is an AI marketing transformation practice: the strategy, the systems and the agents that run a marketing function, engineered end to end. Founded and run by Amber Lan, AI marketing engineer, from Auckland, New Zealand, working worldwide.

Note: Flow AI (flowai.co.nz) is not affiliated with Flow Digital (flow.co.nz), Flow Marketing NZ, or the FLOWAI DISC-assessment product by Discflow.

Key facts:
- Service: AI-run marketing for NZ SMBs: SEO and answer engine optimization, content engine, outbound automation, analytics and reporting.
- Audience: New Zealand small and medium businesses, and early-stage teams without a marketing hire. Australia served remotely.
- Pricing (NZD): Starter sprint $997 one-time (one system, live within days). Marketing engine retainer $1,000/month, cancel anytime, 30-day money-back guarantee on the first month. Founding-client rate locks for as long as the client stays.
- Often compared with: AI marketing agencies, AI automation agencies and AI consultants in Auckland and across New Zealand. Flow AI is the engineered alternative: AI agents for marketing, reviewed by one marketing engineer, delivered as AI marketing transformation one agent at a time.
- Referral: a referral fee for every signed client referred, paid after their first invoice clears.
- Founder: Amber Lan, AI marketing engineer. Runs marketing solo at an AI startup by day on agent systems she built. Native English and Mandarin. Builds with Python, TypeScript, and agentic AI tooling (Claude).
- Contact: amber.lan.growth.digital@gmail.com
- Links: https://www.flowai.co.nz/ · https://github.com/Amberlanqinyun · https://www.linkedin.com/in/amberlan/

About Amber Lan (the person behind Flow AI):
- Who: Amber Lan is an AI marketing engineer and GTM engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand, and the founder of Flow AI. Over ten years across every part of marketing, and three years building the AI agent systems that run it.
- Now: runs the marketing function of an AI startup on an agent stack she built herself; the system does the production, she does the judgment.
- Builds: a content engine with a codified brand voice and quality gate, an answer engine optimisation toolkit (geo-seo-claude), outbound with a human takeover rule, and measurement wired to real numbers. 125 published skills, open source.
- Languages: English and Mandarin (native).
- Roles: marketing engineer, GTM engineer, AI marketing engineer, growth engineer, RevOps / marketing ops engineer. Open to conversations about senior roles, remote from anywhere (based in Auckland, NZT). Contact: amber.lan.growth.digital@gmail.com or https://www.linkedin.com/in/amberlan/

- /sprints/: five of the eleven marketing systems, each installable in a week, one per station of the marketing line (positioning, AI search, content engine, outbound, analytics), each with a public deliverables checklist.
- /skills/: Flow AI skill library with 125 inspectable AI agent skills: 16 built by Flow AI for research, GEO, SEO, content operations, reporting, and product systems, plus curated MIT-licensed libraries: 41 growth playbooks by Iris Wei of Gingiris (launch, growth, community, open source, ASO), 50 marketing skills by Corey Haines (conversion, copywriting, paid media, analytics, sales), 17 social media skills by Charlie Hills (LinkedIn posts, hooks, carousels, reels, profile, analytics), and Humanizer by Siqi Chen for stripping AI writing tells out of prose. Every entry names its author and links to source.
- /skills/research-brand/SKILL.md: portable public workflow that turns a company URL into an evidence-backed Brand DNA brief.
- /skills/reddit-opportunity-research/SKILL.md: public research workflow for finding useful, no-spam participation and content opportunities in public Reddit discussions.
- /skills/audit-content/SKILL.md: public pre-publication workflow for checking links, statistics, source attributions, and brand claims.

- /blog/: guides for owners and marketing leads in New Zealand and Australia, grouped by topic. Filter with /blog/?topic=<topic>.
- /glossary/: plain definitions of AI marketing and AI search terms, free to quote with attribution.
- Topic: AI search (/blog/?topic=ai-search). Getting found by Google and quoted by ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews.
  - /blog/what-is-answer-engine-optimisation.html [pillar]: Answer engine optimisation (AEO) is the work of making your business easy for AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews to find, understand and name in their answers. It builds on normal SEO: crawlable pages, clear facts, direct answers to real questions, and mentions of your business on other trusted sites.
  - /blog/aeo-checklist.html: An AEO checklist for a small business covers six areas: open your site to AI crawlers, publish consistent facts about the business, write pages that answer customer questions directly, earn reviews and mentions elsewhere, add accurate structured data, and track what AI engines say about you. Most owners can work through it in a week.
  - /blog/aeo-vs-seo-vs-geo.html: SEO gets your pages ranked in search results. AEO gets your business quoted or recommended inside the answers AI tools write. GEO is the research term for the same goal in generative AI engines such as ChatGPT and Perplexity. In practice AEO and GEO overlap almost completely, and both rest on good SEO.
  - /blog/how-to-get-mentioned-by-chatgpt.html: There is no form to submit your business to ChatGPT. ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and Copilot build answers from the open web and their search partners, so you get mentioned by being easy to find and confirm: crawlable pages that answer buyer questions, consistent business details, recent reviews, and mentions on sites the assistants already trust.
  - /blog/seo-for-small-business-nz.html: SEO for a New Zealand small business starts with Google, which handles about nine in ten NZ searches. Complete and maintain your Google Business Profile, collect recent reviews every week, give each service and each area you cover its own page, and fix the technical basics in Search Console. Most owners can do the first month themselves.
- Topic: Costs and choices (/blog/?topic=costs). What marketing help costs in New Zealand and Australia, and how to choose.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-cost-australia-new-zealand.html [pillar]: In 2026, AI marketing for a small business costs USD 20 to 99 a month per tool if you do the work yourself, NZD 60 to 150 an hour from a freelancer, NZD 1,500 to 10,000 a month from an agency, or NZD 90,000 to 130,000 a year for an in-house hire. AI marketing agents sit between the tool and the agency.
  - /blog/agency-vs-freelancer-vs-in-house.html: A freelancer is usually cheapest for New Zealand small businesses at NZD 50 to 150 an hour. An agency retainer costs NZD 1,500 to 10,000 a month for more than one channel, and an in-house marketer costs about NZD 76,000 to 167,000 a year once KiwiSaver and overheads are added. Ongoing workload decides which fits.
  - /blog/ai-agency-vs-ai-consultant-nz.html: Choose an AI marketing agency when you want marketing produced and run for you, an AI automation agency when a specific process wastes hours every week, and an AI consultant when you need a plan before you buy anything. If you have staff with time, an in-house person plus an outside engineer can cost less than all three.
  - /blog/do-you-need-an-ai-marketing-agency-nz.html: You need an AI marketing agency when marketing must run every week across more than one channel and nobody inside the business has the hours to run it. Check that the agency runs real AI systems you can see and keep. If you have the time or only one channel, a freelancer or AI tools may serve you better.
  - /blog/fractional-cmo-vs-ai-cmo.html: A fractional CMO is a senior marketer working part time, costing about NZD 4,000 to 10,000 a month in New Zealand and AUD 6,000 to 18,000 in Australia. An AI CMO is software that plans and often produces the work for far less. Choose the person for judgment and accountability, the software for weekly execution, or combine them.
  - /blog/fractional-marketing-manager-nz.html: A fractional marketing manager is an experienced marketer who works for your business part time, usually one or two days a week, owning the plan and the results without a full-time salary. Robert Walters' 2026 guide puts Auckland contract marketing managers at NZD 70 to 105 an hour, roughly NZD 2,450 to 3,700 a month for one day a week.
  - /blog/marketing-agency-alternatives-nz.html: The main alternatives to a marketing agency in New Zealand are doing it yourself with AI tools, a freelancer at NZD 50 to 150 an hour, a fractional marketing manager from about NZD 1,200 a month, a specialist package, an AI-led service, or an in-house hire on NZD 55,000 to 150,000 a year.
  - /blog/marketing-agency-cost-nz.html: Most New Zealand marketing agencies charge NZD 95 to 200 an hour. Monthly retainers run about NZD 500 to 1,500 for one channel, NZD 1,500 to 4,000 for several, and NZD 4,000 to 10,000 or more for full service, plus GST and ad spend. From NZD 1,000 a month, an agency has room to do one channel properly.
- Topic: The AI marketing agent (/blog/?topic=agent). What an AI marketing agent is, what it does, and where the human sits.
  - /blog/what-is-an-ai-marketing-agent.html [pillar]: An AI marketing agent is software that reads your business, decides what marketing to do next, produces the work across several channels and ships it under a human's review. A tool waits to be prompted one task at a time. An agent holds a goal, chooses its next task and reports what changed.
  - /blog/ai-agents-for-marketing.html: Build a positioning brief first, because every marketing agent is briefed from it. Then build the agent for the gap that costs you most, usually search or outbound for a 5 to 50 person business. Install one agent at a time, give it narrow data access, put a human review before anything reaches a customer, and measure enquiries.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-automation-small-business.html: AI marketing automation is software that runs marketing steps on triggers, such as a welcome email after a sign-up, with AI writing, sorting and personalising the content inside each step. A small business should start with six: a welcome sequence, enquiry follow-up, quote follow-up, review requests, abandoned bookings or carts, and re-engagement.
  - /blog/what-is-an-ai-cmo.html: An AI CMO is software that does the planning half of a chief marketing officer's job. It reads the business and its market, sets priorities, writes the marketing plan, briefs the work and reviews the results each cycle. A human still owns positioning, pricing, claims, spend and anything that reaches a customer.
- Topic: Transformation (/blog/?topic=transformation). Moving a small business marketing function onto AI systems, job by job.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-transformation-small-business.html [pillar]: AI marketing transformation for a small business is the move from marketing done in spare hours to marketing run by systems, one job at a time. A practical 90-day path fixes positioning and measurement first, then search and content, then social and outbound, with a human approving everything that reaches a customer.
  - /blog/ai-for-marketers.html: Hand AI the production work of marketing: research, first drafts, repurposing, scheduling, tracking and follow-up. Keep the judgment: positioning, the claim worth making, taste, the call on what ships and conversations with buyers. Put a named person and a short review step between every AI draft and the customer, and measure hours saved alongside enquiries.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-examples.html: Ten practical AI marketing examples for a small business, one per marketing job: a positioning file, AI search answer pages, a weekly guide, one social channel, researched outbound, quote follow-up, a launch kit, review replies, a weekly ad check and a one-screen report. In each, AI drafts the work and a named person approves it.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-for-small-business-nz.html: AI marketing for a New Zealand small business covers four systems: SEO so Google finds you, answer engine optimisation so ChatGPT and AI search quote you, a content engine that publishes every week, and outbound follow-up that never forgets. Most businesses start with one system, prove it, then add the next.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-strategy-small-business.html: Build an AI marketing strategy in five steps: write your positioning and the questions customers ask, hand one or two marketing jobs to AI first, set rules for what a person approves, choose two numbers to measure, and run it for 90 days. Keep it to one page and review it monthly.
  - /blog/content-marketing-small-business-nz.html: Content marketing for a New Zealand small business means publishing useful answers to the questions your customers already ask, on a schedule you can keep. Write one solid piece a fortnight, cut it into social posts, an email and FAQ entries, and check enquiries monthly. Two to four hours a week is enough to start.
  - /blog/outbound-sales-automation.html: Outbound sales automation for a small business means using software and AI to build a target list, research each account, draft short personal emails and send follow-ups on a schedule, while a person approves every first message and handles every reply. In New Zealand and Australia it must also meet spam law on consent, identification and unsubscribing.
- Topic: Reference (/blog/?topic=reference). Statistics and definitions, free to quote with attribution.
  - /blog/ai-marketing-statistics-australia-new-zealand.html [pillar]: Around half of small and medium businesses in Australia and New Zealand now use AI in some form, but far fewer use it to run marketing work end to end. This page collects 62 figures on adoption, marketing use, AI search and time saved, each linked to its primary source and free to quote with attribution.

## What is an AI marketing engineer?

An AI marketing engineer does two jobs that are usually split: they write the go-to-market strategy, and they build the AI systems that execute it. One person designs the positioning and ships the inbound, content, and outbound systems that run it. Flow AI's practitioner rule: claims ship with receipts. The systems are public on GitHub, and client results are only published with real names and real numbers.

## What does AI marketing cost in New Zealand?

Flow AI prices by system: a fixed-scope one-week install, then a monthly run that can be cancelled at any time. Current figures come with the free audit.
